{{Top|leg}}
'''Red Team''' was a unit of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Marines (SpecForce)|Marines]] assigned to [[Operation Cobolt]]. They were assigned to support any unit that needed assistance during the operation. All of Red Team were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the assault.
